info.title: Itential Platform — Whoami Probe (OAuth2)
info.description:
Single-endpoint connectivity probe for verifying Itential Platform API access using OAuth2 client credentials. Returns the authenticated service account identity.

Authentication: OAuth2 Client Credentials — register a service account in Itential Platform and use its client ID and secret.

Source: https://docs.itential.com
